name: @martinthommesen/oc-browser
description: oc-browser: an OpenCode v2 plugin and Chrome extension that let OpenCode drive the browser.
author: Martin Lammetun Thommesen <267603464+martinthommesen@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: tsdown && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('extension/manifest.json', 'utf8')); manifest.version = require('./package.json').version; fs.writeFileSync('dist/extension/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.pretest: node -e "const n=require('node:fs').globSync(['src/**/*.test.ts', 'extension/**/*.test.ts']).length; if (n < 2) { console.error('expected at least 2 test files, found '+n); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.verify:dist: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(m => { if (!m.default?.id) { throw new Error('dist/index.js does not export a plugin') } }); for (const file of ['./dist/tui.js', './dist/extension/manifest.json', './dist/extension/service-worker.js']) { if (!require('node:fs').existsSync(file)) { throw new Error(file + ' is missing') } }"
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run --workspace-root lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:effect && pnpm run build && pnpm test && pnpm run verify:dist && pnpm pack --dry-run
scripts.lint:effect: effect-tsgo diagnostics --project tsconfig.json --strict && effect-tsgo diagnostics --project extension/tsconfig.json --strict
